Processing your recording, do not close RoadLog! You will automatically be prompted to save the file once it\'s ready. This process may take a few minutes if your time frame is big. Once this is finished and you are asked to save the file, please do so and then wait until you see RoadLog\'s main screen again.
RoadLog keeps recording in the background
RoadLog is like a dashcam for your phone. It allows you to record audio and video continuously and save the last 30 minutes at your request.
You are solely responsible for the use of this app

Show your speed on every clip
RoadLog can burn your current speed into the saved video using GPS. This is optional — without it, your clips are still saved and watermarked, just without a speed reading.
Your changes will be applied the next time you start recording

Start recording automatically when RoadLog opens, without needing to tap Start.

Bitrate for the video recording. Only applies to the video itself, not the audio. The actual bitrate may be different depending on what you will be recording.
The actual frame rate may be different. This can for example happen if the device is not able to record with the specified frame rate.
Locks the rear camera\'s focus to the far distance and disables autofocus, so it doesn\'t refocus on the dashboard or windshield instead of the road. Only applies to newly-started recordings.
When off, saving doesn\'t combine the recording into a single file — the individual chunks are moved to the save folder as-is instead. Applies the next time you save.
When dual (front + back) recording is on, records the front/driver-facing stream at a lower quality to save power, since it only needs to verify who was driving. Applies to newly-started recordings.

RoadLog needs the \"draw over other apps\" permission to show the floating preview window while another app is in the foreground. You\'ll be taken to system settings to grant it.

To access the DCIM folder, you need to grant RoadLog the permission to access external storage. RoadLog will only use this permission to write your recordings to the DCIM folder.
RoadLog couldn\'t access or write to the batches folder. Try to choose a different folder or use the internal storage instead. The recording has been aborted.

RoadLog couldn\'t find a file manager app on your phone. Please install a file manager app and try again. If this message still appears, you can try using a custom batches folder in the advanced settings section. RoadLog may not fully work on your device.
Open selected folder in file manager
To view your batches, open the Files app, go to the internal storage and then you will find your batches in following folders:

The final merged recordings will be saved in that folder. Each recording creates a subfolder to store the short batches in (\"%s\" for video recordings). To view the individual batches, you may need to enable hidden files in the Files app.

To protect your privacy, RoadLog stores its batches into its own private, encrypted storage. This storage is only accessible by RoadLog and can\'t be accessed by other apps or by a possible intruder. Once you save the recording, you will be asked where you want to save the recording to.
You can save the current ongoing recording by pressing and holding down on the save button. The recording will continue in the background.
You are low on storage. RoadLog may not function properly. Please free up some space.
You are low on storage. RoadLog may not function properly. Please free up some space. Alternatively, change the batches folder to a different location in the settings.
RoadLog will continuously record and delete old recordings to make space for new ones. You decide how long RoadLog should remember the past.
Where should RoadLog store the batches?

Select where you would like to let RoadLog store the batches of the ongoing recordings. The internal folder is encrypted and only accessible by RoadLog. This folder is recommended if you only want to record a small time frame. If you need a longer time frame, you will most likely need to select a different folder, as the internal storage is very limited.
Please select either the Media Folder or a Custom Folder. RoadLog has not enough space to store the batches in the internal storage. Alternatively, go back one step and select a shorter duration.
You will now be asked to select a folder where RoadLog should store the batches. Please select a folder where you have write access to.
You are ready to start using RoadLog! Go ahead and try it out!
